title: •Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight
caption: •Obi-Wan Kenobi, Jedi Knight (V)
game_text: Deploys -1 to {episode1} sites. During a battle (or duel) with a Dark Jedi, unless Obi-Wan’s Journal on table, may use 1 Force to cancel a just drawn duel, weapon, or battle destiny. Once per game, may ▲ Disarmed. Immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Padawan learner promoted to Jedi Knight after his encounter with Darth Maul. Has sworn to train Anakin Skywalker, even if the Jedi Council forbids it.

notes: Unique. NEW AFFILIATION: printed base is a Republic character (Reflections III, Episode I-style silver frame with the round silver Republic crest disc; wiki subtype Republic) → affiliation "Republic" (no earlier VS card used it; the renderer may need a Republic character frame/disc). Stats POWER 6 / ABILITY 6 / JEDI KNIGHT (label only, as printed); deploy 7 / forfeit 8 (printed 7/8). Inline black 'EPISODE I' circle → {episode1} (stub: 'Episode I sites'); slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Curly apostrophe in Obi-Wan’s. Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow LS helmet), warrior — the printed card has warrior only (the slip adds pilot). Wiki set 'Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty' recorded as 'Reflections III' (build_vs ring-icon key). Lore matches the scan (no bold keywords). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright '© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.' legible. No V<N> remake on the wiki; modern = Virtual Block 5 only (VB5 -pre, 350 px). Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
